contests.title: Norcross City Council — Special Election (unexpired term of Marshall Cheek)

provenance.sourceOrg: City of Norcross, City Clerk/Elections Superintendent
provenance.quote:
Qualified Candidates for 2026 Special Municipal Election
The City of Norcross has announced the qualified candidates for the 2026 Special Municipal Election.
The following candidates qualified during the official qualifying period held September 14–16, 2026:
Jeffrey Allen
Bucky Johnson
The election will be held Tuesday, November 3, 2026, to fill the remainder of the unexpired City Council term previously held by Marshall Cheek. ADVANCE VOTING will be held from Tuesday, October 13, 2026, through Friday, October 30, 2026, and Saturday, Oct. 17, 2026, and Oct. 24, 2026, from 9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. at Norcross City Hall, 65 Lawrenceville Street Norcross, GA 30071.

contests.scopeNote: Complete current official city qualified-candidate announcement for the November 3, 2026 special municipal election, rechecked November 3. This city contest is independently administered and is absent from the county consolidated sample. No actual city candidate sample specimen was acquired; coverage is official-list evidence only. The page lists no printed voting-limit instruction or party labels, so these are not inferred. Only voters within Norcross city limits vote in this office.

sources.sourceOrg: City of Norcross, City Clerk/Elections Superintendent
sources.quote: Only registered voters within the Norcross city limits are eligible to vote in this special election. All qualified residents of the City of Norcross, Georgia, are urged to participate. Those qualified to vote shall be determined in all respects in accordance with and in conformity with the laws of the State of Georgia.

contests.title: Homestead Exemption
contests.scopeNote: Exact unnumbered English question in the current November 3 county consolidated sample. HB540 identifies the electorate as electors of the Gwinnett County school district, not all county voters or all Buford school district voters. The signed act originally names the 2026 general-primary date; it is used here for the exact district electorate only. Current official November sample controls this packet’s election date.

provenance.sourceOrg: Gwinnett County Voter Registrations and Elections
provenance.quote:
Homestead Exemption 

Exención por vivienda familiar 

(Vote for One / Vote por uno) 

Shall the existing additional $2,000 

homestead exemption from Gwinnett 

County School District ad valorem taxes 

for education purposes for certain public 

service employees be expanded to also apply 

to disabled veterans and all employees of 

the Gwinnett County School District and the 

Buford City School District? 

¿Debería ampliarse la actual exención 

de vivienda familiar de $2,000.00 de los 

impuestos ad valorem para fines educativos 

del Distrito Escolar del Condado de Gwinnett 

para ciertos emple ados de servicios 

públicos para que también se expanda y 

beneficie a los veteranos discapacitados y a 

todos los empleados del Distrito Escolar del 

Condado de Gwinnett y del Distrito Escolar 

de la Ciudad de Buford? 

Yes / Sí 

No 

Abbreviation Definition / Definición de abreviatura: 

(I)(T) = Incumbent, Titular 

Rep = Republican, Republicano 

Dem = Democrat, Demócrata

sources.quote:
